physics.disabled_behavior: Keep static spell visuals and object positions, stop all active spell motion and orbit states, and pause White Hole inventory ejection. Re-enabling physics immediately re-evaluates active fields for every object.

during_physics.behavior: Snap each object affected by spell physics to the center of its current tile on every physics update.

on_physics_end.behavior: Snap an object to the center of its current tile when its continuous spell motion ends or an orbit exits. Skip the snap when an active field takes over immediately.

influence_visualization.behavior: Draw the radius of influence around active Black Hole, White Hole, and Gravity Star fields in the play area. This visualization is a debug view and does not change spell physics.

black_hole.resolve: immediately when the input is accepted inside the nearest beat or half-beat judgment window
black_hole.rhythm_judgment: shared with movement; one accepted action per beat slot, with full-beat and half-beat slots
black_hole.target: the adjacent tile in Jerv's last facing direction
black_hole.success: remove the object from the target tile and push it onto the top of the inventory stack
black_hole.empty_target: leave the inventory unchanged and show empty-target feedback

static_effect.behavior: Continuously attract in-range objects along a shrinking spiral around the center; orbiting motion remains active until the object is absorbed.
static_effect.capture: remove the object at the center and push it onto the top of the inventory stack
static_effect.recast: stop the previous pull when its static instance begins to disappear
static_effect.movement: Continuous pixel motion with angular orbit and inward spiral; the radius decreases until capture. A new Black Hole motion replaces any current orbit or spell motion for the affected object.

white_hole.resolve: immediately when the input is accepted inside the nearest beat or half-beat judgment window
white_hole.rhythm_judgment: shared with movement; one accepted action per beat slot, with full-beat and half-beat slots
white_hole.target: the adjacent tile in Jerv's last facing direction
white_hole.success: pop the top item from the inventory stack and place it on the target tile
white_hole.empty_inventory: leave the target tile unchanged and show empty-inventory feedback
white_hole.blocked_target: if the target tile is occupied or outside the grid, keep the item on top of the inventory stack

static_effect.behavior: when the full loop appears, move every object in range to the center and launch it outward from there in a uniformly random direction

inventory_ejection.source: objects absorbed by Black Hole and held in the shared inventory stack
inventory_ejection.behavior: while the full White Hole loop is active, eject the top inventory item from the White Hole center in a random direction, one item at a time until the stack is empty

static_effect.settling: objects slow to rest at their continuous position without tile snapping
static_effect.wall_bounds: the internal walkable room bounds, with 8 pixels of object clearance from the room edges
static_effect.movement: continuous pixel motion; a new White Hole launch replaces any current orbit or spell motion for the affected object
static_effect.random_direction: uniformly random angle over 0 to 2π, independently for each object

static_effects.creation_sequence: Shift+A/S/D plays the corresponding short cast animation first; when it finishes, the complete static loop appears at the target tile. If the same static type already exists, that instance plays its matching short cast animation in reverse while the new instance is cast. D alone only plays the gravity-star animation and has no gameplay effect.
static_effects.replacement: A new static cast reverses the matching short cast animation at the old instance while playing it forward at the new target. The old instance is removed and the new loop is placed when the cast ends or is interrupted by another accepted action; the other type remains on the map.
static_effects.initial_instance_appearance: all three effects begin in their full static loop state; the scene does not replay their creation casts on startup

motion_handoff.behavior: Re-evaluate active static fields continuously for every object, including objects already in motion or orbit; an in-range Black Hole takes priority and captures objects along an inward spiral, then a Gravity Star with a fixed 128 px influence radius preserves the entered orbital distance while constraining positions to the walkable room, then an unspent White Hole instance.
motion_handoff.white_hole_repeat: each field object is launched at most once by each White Hole loop instance; inventory items absorbed by Black Hole are emitted from the active White Hole one at a time every 0.35 seconds until the stack is empty

feedback.target_tile: outline the tile Jerv is facing, print its bottom-left tile coordinate on the tile, and show the coordinate in the sidebar
feedback.inventory: show stack size and its top item in the INVENTARIO sidebar group
feedback.last_action: retain the latest absorbed, expelled, or no-effect result as runtime state; do not display it in the sidebar

object_trajectory.trail: sample each moving object position every 45 ms and fade the trail after 1.5 seconds
object_trajectory.coordinates: current bottom-left tile coordinates remain available in runtime state; do not list them in the sidebar
object_trajectory.jump_event: record motion-state changes and per-frame position deltas larger than 12 pixels or 1.5 times the fastest expected frame displacement, whichever is greater; include previous and current screen-pixel coordinates; do not list events in the sidebar

gravity_star.mode: D is a visual-only short cast; Shift+D creates the static field
gravity_star.resolve: D and Shift+D are resolved inside the nearest beat or half-beat judgment window
gravity_star.rhythm_judgment: shared with movement and other abilities; one accepted action per beat slot, with full-beat and half-beat slots
gravity_star.target: the adjacent tile in Jerv's last facing direction

short_cast.behavior: play gravity_star_cast at the adjacent target tile without placing a static loop or affecting objects

gravity_star.success: Shift+D plays gravity_star_cast and places one gravity_star_static_loop at the target tile
gravity_star.effect: Shift+D: objects within the fixed 128 px influence radius enter a continuous circular orbit when the star appears; preserve their current distance without radial projection. The orbit has a 6-second period and is independent of BPM; each orbit position is continuously constrained to the walkable room bounds.

orbital_motion.model: continuous angular orbit that preserves the entry radius, with each resulting position continuously constrained to the walkable room bounds
orbital_motion.distance: preserve each eligible object’s exact distance when it enters the 128 px influence radius; do not project it radially
orbital_motion.movement: continuous pixel positions without tile snapping by default, independent of BPM; clamp orbit positions continuously at walkable room edges
orbital_motion.room_bounds: the 128 px influence radius stays fixed; orbit positions are constrained to the walkable room bounds without radial projection or teleporting
orbital_motion.zero_distance: an object at the star's center remains there

on_physics_end.field_handoff: skip tile snapping when another active field takes over immediately, so the snap cannot push the object outside that field
